ResearchProjectDef.label: early-warning radar
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct microwave radar domes and coastal acoustic sonar stations to detect incoming world-map raids, caravans, and maritime threats far beyond visual line of sight.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->monitored orbital approach corridors during the rim-wide wars
subject_story->designed microwave transceiver antennas for remote border colonies
subject_story->mapped atmospheric backscatter and radio propagation across the hemisphere

ResearchProjectDef.label: phased radar arrays
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct high-power electronically steerable phased array radar stations. Operating multiple dishes on the same local grid achieves synthetic aperture interferometry, drastically extending identification horizons and sweep rates.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->pioneered digital beamforming algorithms for deep-space telemetry
subject_story->calibrated interferometric baselines across planetary station clusters
subject_story->integrated synthetic aperture radar imaging for trans-orbital reconnaissance

ResearchProjectDef.label: signals intelligence decryption
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct ultra-tech signals intelligence (SIGINT) consoles that link directly to phased radar arrays, deciphering encrypted military datalinks to yield precise force headcounts, weaponry, and ETA while penetrating mountainous terrain masking.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->cracked quantum cryptosystems during the mechanoid border campaigns
subject_story->reverse-engineered military cipher transceivers salvaged from coreworld derelicts
subject_story->designed real-time tactical cryptanalysis mainframes for command nodes
